selection.reason: Retain the pass 10 implementation. Eight-lane S-box scheduling reduced the matched four-input row-hash GPU event sum by 0.330%, but complete aggregation medians changed by -0.105% (four inputs), +0.121% (eight inputs), and +0.007% (two concurrent jobs), with only 3 of 7 aggregate pairs faster. Native JoinSplit improved by 1.335% pooled and 1.135% paired, with 9 of 12 pairs faster; this positive result is retained and does not establish a broad aggregation benefit. Sampled single-job GPU peak increased 428 MiB; four-input peak was unchanged and concurrent peak was 1344 MiB lower. The candidate does not meet the prespecified requirement for broadly consistent complete-proof benefit. All four NTT candidates were rejected after large-transform regressions, and the two smaller S-box schedules were mixed.

correctness_argument.scope: Reorder independent full-round S-box operations only, behind the existing NVIDIA field-carry gate.
correctness_argument.per_lane: For each lane compute a=gl_add(s,rc), x2=gl_mul(a,a), x3=gl_mul(x2,a), x4=gl_mul(x2,x2), and s=gl_mul(x4,x3). These are exactly the baseline operands and operations.
correctness_argument.independence: Each of eight lanes reads only its own pre-round state and round constant. The external mixing layer starts only after all eight final products. Partial rounds remain sequential and unchanged.
correctness_argument.fallback: Four preprocessor configurations without NVIDIA field-carry are token-identical to the baseline.
correctness_argument.coverage: Independent integer Poseidon2 oracle, full-u64 arithmetic oracle, full-output row hashes, existing GPU arithmetic and commitment tests, and fresh complete proofs audited by unchanged CPU verifiers.
correctness_argument.resource_policy: No new buffers, host allocation changes, launch geometry, memory budgets, synchronization or power changes. More simultaneously live scalar temporaries may affect compiler register scheduling, so complete-proof measurements are required.

hash_confirmation_plan.reason: Initial eight-lane interleaving result is small (median 0.62%, five of six shapes positive), so confirm reproducibility before complete-proof qualification. sbox2 and sbox4 are mixed and do not advance.
hash_confirmation_plan.order: AB on even repetitions, BA on odd; each output checked before timing; same source and GPU resource policy

references.application: Motivated fourth-root shift and radix-4 NTT experiments. Actual forward and inverse roots were checked explicitly; correctness passed, but large transforms regressed.

references.title: NVIDIA Volta Tuning Guide
references.application: Motivated experiments exposing independent arithmetic and checking synchronization and register-pressure tradeoffs. Applying these CUDA architecture observations to OpenCL is an inference; timings establish the result.

research.method: Userspace OpenCL event profiling and bounded fresh-proof controllers. No kernel profiler, driver, clock or power changes.

native_clock_observations.interpretation: Process-relative sampled clocks are not per-kernel clock measurements. The warm diagnostic profiles began at different sampled clocks; unchanged NTT durations also differed. Every native qualification run for both labels began at a sampled 135 MHz. Subsequent per-kernel clocks were not measured. Do not assign the complete native difference to S-box scheduling. Clock and power settings were never changed.

early-ntt-screen.execution_schedule: In-place intermediate groups, separate first input and final bit-reversed destination
early-ntt-screen.resource_policy: Exclusive GPU; one output pair per selected variant plus one input; original 48 KiB local-memory cap and fallback preserved.

timing_boundaries.four: Aggregation plus GPU drain; excludes initialization, output writing and CPU audit.
timing_boundaries.single: Worker launch through exit, including initialization, admission barrier, proof work, output and shutdown; excludes independent CPU audit.
timing_boundaries.concurrent: Cohort launch through the last of two worker exits; same boundary as single-worker runs.
timing_boundaries.wallet: Native ABI proof call plus GPU drain; excludes initialization, buffer setup, output and CPU audit.

limitations: One Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB, fixed 250 W power limit; no clocks or power settings changed.
Three four-input, two eight-input, two concurrent and twelve native matched pairs; small sample counts limit precision.
First-use compilation, warmups and profiling runs are retained separately and excluded from qualification medians.
Kernel screens measure GPU events, not complete-prover latency. Candidate selection uses the complete-proof comparisons.
GPU-event sums and inclusive host spans are nonadditive. Uncovered intervals are not measured GPU idle time.
Sampled native VRAM peaks may miss short allocations; zero sampled usage is not zero actual use.
No cold-cache, other-GPU, Apple, full-block or production qualification claim.
